claim: Castel di Sangro's neighbouring municipalities (Roccaraso, Pescocostanzo, Rivisondoli, San Pietro Avellana, Montenero Val Cocchiara) and location in the Apennines, province of L'Aquila.
quote: Neighbouring towns include Roccaraso, Pescocostanzo, Rivisondoli, San Pietro Avellana and Montenero Val Cocchiara.

claim: Driving distance from Isernia to Castel di Sangro is ~30 km, ~35 min.
quote: Distanza in auto: 30,48 km / Tempo di percorrenza: circa 35 minuti.

claim: Driving distance Castel di Sangro to Sulmona is ~44 km, ~45 min, via SS17 (no autostrada).
quote: Distanza stradale Castel di Sangro - Sulmona: 44,06 km. Tempo di percorrenza in auto: circa 45 minuti, via SS17.

claim: Castel di Sangro's 2026 'Muovi l'estate' programme is entirely sports: football, futsal, swimming, basketball, fencing, tennis/padel — no technology track.
quote: Dal 1° maggio al via 'Muovi l'estate 2026' — tornei e campus in tutta la città: calcio, futsal, nuoto, basket, scherma, tennis e padel.

claim: Eni Joule × Niko Romito MEAL Demo Week was held 5-7 May 2026 at the Niko Romito Academy in Castel di Sangro with four finalist startups (Meala Foodtech, Onima, Summ Ingredients, Foreverland Food).
quote: Demo Week, May 5-7 2026, at the Niko Romito Academy in Castel di Sangro — co-development process with four finalist startups: Meala Foodtech, Onima, Summ Ingredients, Foreverland Food.

claim: MEAL is a 'Lab to Market' programme by Joule (Eni's accelerator), Enilive and the Niko Romito Academy targeting startups and SMEs in food retail.
quote: Eni, Enilive e Accademia Niko Romito lanciano MEAL, il primo programma 'Lab to Market' rivolto a startup e PMI.

claim: Tech conferences listed as 'in Pescara 2026/2027' on dev.events are online-only events accessible from Pescara, not physical conferences in the city.
quote: Pescara-specific results display only online events that can be attended remotely from the city — virtual/online conferences, with some having physical locations in other cities.

claim: GSSI SPACERAISE international summer school runs 4-22 May 2026 in L'Aquila, multidisciplinary CS + space-tech.
quote: SPACERAISE summer school will take place in L'Aquila from May 4 to 22, 2026 — promoted by Gran Sasso Tech (GST) and the Gran Sasso Science Institute (GSSI).

claim: L'Aquila Software Tech Forum is held 16 May 2026, 09:30 at UnivAQ Aula Magna; free with mandatory registration; topics: complexity, security, scalability, AI/automation/distributed systems.
quote: Il Software Tech Forum si terrà il 16 maggio 2026 alle 9:30 nell'Aula Magna del Dipartimento di Scienze Umane dell'Università dell'Aquila. Partecipazione gratuita previa registrazione.

claim: FAIEMA 2026 (4th International Conference on Frontiers of AI, Ethics & Multidisciplinary Applications) is held 9-11 September 2026 in L'Aquila, in person, Springer-published.
quote: The 4th International Conference on Frontiers of Artificial Intelligence, Ethics, and Multidisciplinary Applications — September 9-11, 2026, in L'Aquila, Italy. Accepted papers published through Springer.

claim: AI-QUILA is a 2026 cultural/AI project across the L'Aquila earthquake-crater area — three thematic laboratories with schools and universities, not a public conference.
quote: AI-QUILA opera su tutto il cratere sismico — tre laboratori tematici in scuole e università, evento finale di restituzione.

claim: L'Aquila is the Italian Capital of Culture 2026, with 300+ days and 600+ events spanning visual arts, music, science and civic participation; cultural hackathon and AI/AR strands included.
quote: L'Aquila Capitale italiana della Cultura 2026 — 300 giorni, oltre 600 eventi, hackathon culturale per under 35, tecnologie di realtà aumentata.

claim: We Make Future 2026 — Italy's largest AI/digital innovation festival — runs 24-26 June 2026 at BolognaFiere (~350 km from Castel di Sangro), reachable but well outside any 'near Reale' radius.
quote: WMF — We Make Future 2026, 24-26 giugno BolognaFiere. Oltre 90 palchi, 1000+ relatori internazionali su AI, marketing digitale e innovazione.

claim: Driving distance Castel di Sangro to L'Aquila is ~110 km, ~1h46.
quote: Distanza stradale Castel di Sangro - L'Aquila: 110 km. Tempo di percorrenza: 1 ora e 46 minuti.
